name: out-of-stock-auto-hide
description: When a product sells out, hides it from the store or marks it as on backorder, and puts it back as soon as stock returns. Only products it hid itself are restored.

howItWorks.label: Sold out
howItWorks.text: Hides the product, or marks it as on backorder, when its stock reaches 0

howItWorks.label: Back in stock
howItWorks.text: Restores the products it hid, as soon as stock is above 0 again

howItWorks.label: Runs on its own
howItWorks.text: No approval step; it changes one field and nothing else

howItWorks.label: Optional
howItWorks.text: Posts each change to a Slack channel

plugins.reason: Posts what was hidden and restored to a channel

data.description: The field that controls whether customers can see or buy the product: a published flag, a status, or an availability value such as in stock / backorder
The SKU, for the Slack message
A per-product flag for products that may keep selling at 0 stock

parameters.label: When a product sells out
parameters.description: Hide it from the store, or keep it visible as on backorder

parameters.label: Value that hides the product
parameters.description: What the availability field is set to when a product sells out, e.g. unpublished, draft, false or backorder

parameters.label: Slack channel
parameters.description: Optional; where hidden and restored products are posted
